text: {"lessons":["A rising account value is encouraging, but I should make decisions from each stock’s prospects and my overall allocation—not simply from recent gains.","Selling Stock D and E after substantial gains felt satisfying, but I should avoid taking profits automatically; consider whether each position still merits its place in the portfolio.","I added to Stock C as its price rose. Before buying more, I should check concentration, risk, and whether the investment case still justifies the added exposure."]}
